title: "Scroll prototype"

[Demo data]{.demo-badge}

This page is a technical test: one chart that changes as you scroll. Every number here is simulated.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r scrolly_points}
set.seed(8105)

# TODO: replace with the real hospital-level summary for one condition
demo_hospitals =
  tibble(
    name = str_c("Demo Hospital ", 1:60),
    median_charge = rlnorm(60, meanlog = log(40000), sdlog = 0.45),
    adjusted_charge = median_charge * exp(rnorm(60, mean = 0, sd = 0.2))
  )

charge_range = range(log(c(demo_hospitals$median_charge, demo_hospitals$adjusted_charge)))

rescale_charge = function(x) {
  (log(x) - charge_range[1]) / (charge_range[2] - charge_range[1])
}

scrolly_points =
  demo_hospitals |>
  mutate(
    x_raw = rescale_charge(median_charge),
    x_adj = rescale_charge(adjusted_charge),
    y_cloud = runif(n(), min = 0.15, max = 0.85),
    y_rank = (rank(-median_charge) - 1) / (n() - 1),
    grp = case_when(
      rank(-median_charge) <= 5 ~ "high",
      rank(median_charge) <= 5 ~ "low",
      TRUE ~ "mid"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 4)))

tick_values = c(15000, 25000, 40000, 65000, 100000)

scrolly_ticks =
  tibble(
    x = rescale_charge(tick_values),
    label = scales::label_dollar()(tick_values)
  ) |>
  filter(x >= 0, x <= 1)

raw_ratio = max(demo_hospitals$median_charge) / min(demo_hospitals$median_charge)
adj_ratio = max(demo_hospitals$adjusted_charge) / min(demo_hospitals$adjusted_charge)

scrolly_states =
  tibble(
    x = c("x_raw", "x_raw", "x_raw", "x_adj"),
    y = c("y_cloud", "y_rank", "y_rank", "y_rank"),
    highlight = c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE),
    readout = c(
      "60 hospitals, one condition",
      "Ranked from highest to lowest median charge",
      str_c("Highest / lowest: ", round(raw_ratio, 1), "x"),
      str_c("After adjustment, highest / lowest: ", round(adj_ratio, 1), "x")
    )
  )
```

```{r scrolly_data, results = "asis"}
# Hand the data to the page; js/scrolly.js reads this block
scrolly_json =
  jsonlite::toJSON(
    list(
      points = scrolly_points |> select(name, x_raw, x_adj, y_cloud, y_rank, grp),
      ticks = scrolly_ticks,
      states = scrolly_states,
      axis_title = "Median charge per stay (log scale)"
    ),
    dataframe = "rows",
    auto_unbox = TRUE
  )

cat('<script type="application/json" id="scrolly-data">', scrolly_json, "</script>", sep = "\n")
```
